# Gantrel

> A local-AI 3D design studio, starting with 3D printing, then product design. Status: planned, not released; check SUPPORTED.md before doing any step.

Cloud providers are personal use only and live only in Fonsviva. Apps never hold provider keys. UntoCaesar client work and UniCerebrum are blocked from cloud.

## Setup
- [For agents: quickstart](https://baney75.github.io/Gantrel/agents): rules and order of steps
- [Install](https://baney75.github.io/Gantrel/setup/install): steps, checks, expected output
- [Connect to Fonsviva](https://baney75.github.io/Gantrel/setup/connect-fonsviva)
- [Select models](https://baney75.github.io/Gantrel/setup/select-models)
- [Add a cloud provider](https://baney75.github.io/Gantrel/setup/add-cloud-provider)
- [Troubleshoot](https://baney75.github.io/Gantrel/setup/troubleshoot)
